name: Asri Karya Lestari Tbk.
summary: PT Asri Karya Lestari Tbk operates as an Indonesian general contracting company, undertaking a diverse range of construction projects. Its primary endeavors include building infrastructure such as bridges, various types of buildings, toll gates, bus stops, and pedestrian overpasses (JPOs), as well as religious structures like mosques. In addition to its construction activities, the company also provides heavy equipment rental services. Established in 2008, PT Asri Karya Lestari Tbk is based in Bekasi, Indonesia, and is a subsidiary of Sudjatmiko.
